prompt: How does mgSCALE detect when a container has been refilled?
choices: By manual entry from the technician after each refill
Automatically, using sensor data from the container
Via a scheduled daily report from the branch manager
Through a QR code scan at the refill station

prompt: A new detection card appears for tank T-08. After reviewing it, you confirm the reading is accurate. Which button records this as an official refill event?
choices: View History
Dismiss
Add Log
Confirm Threshold

prompt: A sensor flags a refill on tank T-11, but the LN2 weight reading appears inaccurate. What is the correct action from the pending detection card?
choices: Add it as a confirmed log and raise a support ticket later
Dismiss the detection to remove it from the pending queue
Delete the container record and re-register it
Ignore it — the system will auto-clear stale detections

prompt: Which fields must be completed manually when confirming a refill in the Add Log form?
choices: Container code and LN2 weight
Date, time, and reservoir name
Who performed the refill and any notes
Branch and sensor reading

prompt: A branch manager needs to verify who refilled tank T-03 last Friday and how much LN2 was added. Which section shows this information?
choices: Refill Detected cards
Recent Activity Log
Active Tank Status
Reservoir Logs

prompt: Why are certain containers flagged in the Active Tank Status panel?
choices: They have an unresolved sensor error
They have not been assigned to a technician
They are approaching the minimum LN2 threshold
They have exceeded the maximum refill frequency

prompt: Tank T-11 is highlighted in the Active Tank Status panel. What does this indicate?
choices: A refill is already in progress for this container
The container has a pending sensor calibration request
The container's LN2 level has dropped below the minimum threshold
The container has exceeded its maximum refill frequency

prompt: You want to review the complete refill history of tank T-05 — every date, technician, and quantity on record. How do you open this view?
choices: Click the tank row in the Refill Detected section
Filter the Recent Activity Log by tank code
Click the View button on the tank row in Active Tank Status
Download the CSV from Reservoir Logs

prompt: Your clinic receives a bulk LN2 delivery for the Mumbai branch reservoir. Where in the Refill Log should this be recorded?
choices: Add a new card in the Refill Detected section
Log it against each affected container in the Recent Activity Log
Record it in the Reservoir Logs section under the Mumbai branch
Update the LN2 threshold in Alert Configuration

prompt: What should you update in Reservoir Logs once a bulk LN2 delivery arrives at a branch?
choices: The minimum LN2 threshold for that branch reservoir
The container count assigned to that reservoir
The technician responsible for accepting the delivery
The received date to complete the order record
